# nd_fabric_group_vxlan_aci (Resource)

Manages the configuration of a VXLAN-ACI fabric group in Nexus Dashboard.

Fabric-group membership is managed separately. Remove member fabrics before
deleting the group. Add the ACI fabric before the NX-OS fabrics and remove it
last. Detach and deploy Nexus Dashboard-owned policies before removing the ACI
fabric. VXLAN-ACI fabric groups are limited to one Nexus Dashboard cluster;
the ACI fabric requires border gateways, telemetry enabled during onboarding,
and Orchestration disabled. The group type is fixed to VXLAN-ACI.

Import uses the fabric-group name. Create and update can complete asynchronously.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nd_fabric_group_vxlan_aci" "test_resource_fabric_group_vxlan_aci_1" {
  fabric_name                          = "tf-fabric-group-vxlan-aci"
  l2_vni_range                         = "30000-49000"
  l3_vni_range                         = "50000-59000"
  anycast_gateway_mac                  = "0022.bdf8.19ff"
  multisite_overlay_inter_connect_type = "directPeering"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `anycast_gateway_mac` (String) The shared anycast gateway MAC address for all VTEPs, in `xxxx.xxxx.xxxx` format. It must match the APIC bridge-domain MAC and the NX-OS member fabrics.
- `fabric_name` (String) The name of the VXLAN-ACI fabric group. Changing the name replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `auto_multisite_underlay_inter_connect` (Boolean) Controls automatic multi-site underlay interconnect configuration. Defaults to `false` when not specified in the configuration.
- `border_gateway_routing_tag` (Number) The routing tag associated with loopback and DCI interface IP addresses for NX fabrics. Valid values are 0 through 4294967295. Defaults to `54321` when not specified in the configuration.
- `enable_ms_overlay_ifc_bgp_desc` (Boolean) Generates BGP neighbor descriptions for automatically created multi-site overlay inter-fabric links. Defaults to `true` when not specified in the configuration.
- `l2_vni_range` (String) The overlay network identifier range. Identifiers must be between 1 and 16777214. Defaults to `30000-49000` when not specified in the configuration.
- `l3_vni_range` (String) The overlay VRF identifier range. Identifiers must be between 1 and 16777214. Defaults to `50000-59000` when not specified in the configuration.
- `multisite_delay_restore` (Number) The multi-site underlay and overlay control-plane convergence delay in seconds. Valid values are 30 through 1000. Defaults to `300` when not specified in the configuration.
- `multisite_inter_connect_bgp_auth_key_type` (String) The BGP authentication key encryption type. Allowed values are `3des`, `type6`, or `type7`. Defaults to `3des` when not specified in the configuration.
- `multisite_inter_connect_bgp_authentication` (Boolean) Enables BGP authentication for the multi-site interconnect. Defaults to `false` when not specified in the configuration.
- `multisite_inter_connect_bgp_key` (String, Sensitive) The encrypted BGP authentication key. It must contain 1 through 256 characters without whitespace. This is sensitive authentication material; preserve the configured value when the API omits it from readback.
- `multisite_loopback_id` (Number) The multi-site loopback identifier for NX fabrics. Valid values are 0 through 1023. Defaults to `100` when not specified in the configuration.
- `multisite_loopback_ip_range` (String) The IPv4 CIDR range typically used for Loopback100. Defaults to `10.10.0.0/24` when not specified in the configuration.
- `multisite_overlay_inter_connect_type` (String) The multi-site overlay interconnect method. Allowed values are `manual`, `routeServer`, or `directPeering`. The `routeServer` option for VXLAN-ACI requires Nexus Dashboard 4.3.1 or later. Defaults to `directPeering` when not specified in the configuration.
- `multisite_underlay_subnet_range` (String) The IPv4 CIDR range used for point-to-point DCI links. Defaults to `10.10.1.0/24` when not specified in the configuration.
- `multisite_underlay_subnet_target_mask` (Number) The target prefix length for the multi-site underlay subnet range. Valid values are 8 through 31. Defaults to `30` when not specified in the configuration.
- `route_server_collection` (Attributes List) The multi-site route servers used with the `routeServer` interconnect method on supported Nexus Dashboard versions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--route_server_collection))
- `route_server_redistribute_direct_route_map` (Boolean) Enables automatic creation of multi-site overlay inter-fabric links on route servers. This setting applies only when the deployment method is `routeServer`. Defaults to `false` when not specified in the configuration.
- `route_server_routing_tag` (Number) The routing tag associated with the route-server IP for redistribute-direct eBGP EVPN peering. Valid values are 0 through 4294967295. Defaults to `54321` when not specified in the configuration.
- `scheduled_backup` (Boolean) Enables daily configuration backup. When enabled, configure `scheduled_backup_time` as well.
- `scheduled_backup_time` (String) The UTC time for daily configuration backup, from `00:00` through `23:59` in 24-hour `HH:MM` format. Configure only when `scheduled_backup` is true.
- `security_group_tag` (String) The security-group mode. Allowed values are `loose` or `strict`. In `strict` mode, only child fabrics with security groups enabled are allowed. Defaults to `strict` when not specified in the configuration.
- `security_group_tag_id_range` (String) The security-group tag identifier range. Identifiers must be between 16 and 65535. Defaults to `10000-14000` when not specified in the configuration.
- `security_group_tag_mac_segmentation` (Boolean) Enables MAC-based segmentation for security groups. Defaults to `false` when not specified in the configuration.
- `security_group_tag_prefix` (String) The prefix used for newly created security groups. It must contain 1 through 10 letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores. Defaults to `SG_` when not specified in the configuration.
- `security_group_tag_preprovision` (Boolean) Generates security-group configuration for non-enforced VRFs. Defaults to `false` when not specified in the configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Terraform identifier of the fabric group, derived from its name.
- `security_group_status` (String) The security-group status returned by the API. Allowed values are `enabled`, `enabledStrict`, `enabledLoose`, `enablePending`, `enablePendingStrict`, `enablePendingLoose`, `disablePending`, or `disabled`.

<a id="nestedatt--route_server_collection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `route_server_collection`

Optional:

- `route_server_asn` (String) The route-server autonomous system number. Use an integer from 1 to 4294967295 or dotted notation with a first component from 1 to 65535 and a second component from 0 to 65535, matching the OpenAPI ASN pattern.
- `route_server_ip` (String) The IPv4 or IPv6 address of the route server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Format of ID used for import:
# fabric_name
terraform import nd_fabric_group_vxlan_aci.test_resource_fabric_group_vxlan_aci my_fabric_group
```
